method: Read official public pages; inspect current JDo source and exercise synthetic trips in desktop/mobile Chromium. Competitor native apps were not installed or tested.

sources.observed: Place lists, moving/deleting saved places and directions are documented.
sources.judgment: Make existing personal-place storage usable without assigning an itinerary day.
sources.implemented: SavedPlaces access, local search, save/edit/delete, explicit insertion into selected day

sources.observed: Daily schedules, place times, route time/distance, directions and compact view are documented.
sources.judgment: Expose the existing full-trip overview before date selection, preserving untimed planning and real route behavior.
sources.implemented: Relocated lazy overview, local itinerary search, separate reservations and untimed counts

sources.observed: Reservation consolidation, inbox sync, sharing, offline access and map/navigation are described by the vendor.
sources.judgment: Prioritize finding locally stored booking details; avoid broad new email permissions and invented live flight data.
sources.implemented: Local reservation search by flight, airports, hotel, reference, dates and notes
sources.notImplemented: Email ingestion and live flight monitoring

sources.observed: Trip shortcuts, next activity, date-appropriate itinerary, expenses/documents and latest undated activities are described.
sources.judgment: Keep explicit reservation and finance entry focused rather than repeating every planning control.
sources.implemented: Focused bottom-nav task pages with planning return; preserve selected trip/day and restart mode
sources.notImplemented: Competitor widget customization or iOS development

limits: Reading date is not publication date or independent validation of all vendor claims.
No paid feature, pricing or ranking comparison was made.
No competitor photos, screenshots, logos, text or code were copied into the app.
Examples and screenshots use synthetic travel records only.
